correctness.rationale: For every integer a,b, the source fan has eight primitive rays and twelve listed maximal cones. Every toric isomorphism gives a ray permutation preserving these twelve triples; full enumeration of all 8! permutations yields exactly eight candidates. Rays 1,2,4 form an integral unimodular basis, so the unique forced lattice matrix for each candidate is obtained from their images. Independent symbolic Gröbner elimination of all 24 ray-coordinate constraints gives the unit ideal for six candidates and only a−b=0 (identity) or a+b+4=0 (nonidentity). The explicit matrix U_a=[[-1,0,0],[-a−2,0,−1],[-a−2,−1,0]] has determinant +1, sends the rays as required and obeys U_{−a−4}U_a=I. Hence toric isomorphism iff b=a or -a-4, with unique parameter representative a≥−2, and exactly at a=−2 a second fan automorphism. This classifies only toric isomorphisms and fan-preserving lattice maps, not abstract automorphisms.
